└── .env.example

الجزء 1: محرك تحليل النصوص

قبل إعادة صياغة النص، عليك أن تفهمه. يحسب محرك التحليل سهولة القراءة باستخدام صيغة Flesch Reading Ease (0 = صعب جدًا، 100 = سهل جدًا)، ويقيس تعقيد الجمل، ويحدّد أنماط تكرار الكلمات. توجّه هذه المقاييس خط أنابيب التحويل وتمنح المستخدمين مقارنة “قبل مقابل بعد”.

Python 

# analyzer.py - محرك تحليل النصوص لـ ProseAI

import re
from collections import Counter

class TextAnalyzer:
    """تحليل النص لسهولة القراءة والتعقيد وتكرار الكلمات."""

    def count_syllables(self, word):
        """تقدير عدد المقاطع الصوتية باستخدام أسلوب تجميع الحروف الصوتية."""
        word = word.lower().strip()
        if len(word) == 0:
            return 0
        if word.endswith("e") and len(word) > 2:
            word = word[:-1]
        vowels = "aeiou"
        count = 0
        prev_vowel = False
        for ch in word:
            is_vowel = ch in vowels
            if is_vowel and not prev_vowel:
                count += 1
            prev_vowel = is_vowel
        return max(count, 1)

    def split_sentences(self, text):
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        return [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]

    def get_words(self, text):
        return re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z]+", text.lower())

    def flesch_reading_ease(self, text):
        """Flesch Reading Ease: 90-100 سهل جدًا، 0-30 صعب جدًا."""
        sentences = self.split_sentences(text)
        words = self.get_words(text)
        if not sentences or not words:
            return 0.0
        total_syl = sum(self.count_syllables(w) for w in words)
        asl = len(words) / len(sentences)
        asw = total_syl / len(words)
        score = 206.835 - (1.015 * asl) - (84.6 * asw)
        return round(max(0, min(100, score)), 1)

    def analyze(self, text):
        """تحليل نصي كامل: سهولة القراءة، التعقيد، التكرار."""
        sentences = self.split_sentences(text)
        words = self.get_words(text)
        if not words:
            return {"error": "No text to analyze"}
        syl_counts = [self.count_syllables(w) for w in words]
        freq = Counter(words)
        complex_words = [w for w, s in zip(words, syl_counts) if s >= 3]
        avg_sl = len(words) / max(len(sentences), 1)
        avg_syl = sum(syl_counts) / len(words)
        grade = 0.39 * avg_sl + 11.8 * avg_syl - 15.59
        return {
            "word_count": len(words),
            "sentence_count": len(sentences),
            "avg_sentence_length": round(avg_sl, 1),
            "flesch_reading_ease": self.flesch_reading_ease(text),
            "grade_level": round(max(0, grade), 1),
            "vocabulary_richness": round(len(set(words)) / len(words), 3),
            "complex_word_pct": round(len(complex_words) / len(words) * 100, 1),
            "top_words": freq.most_common(5),
        }

    def reading_level_label(self, score):
        if score >= 80: return "Easy (6th grade or below)"
        elif score >= 60: return "Standard (8th-9th grade)"
        elif score >= 40: return "Difficult (10th-12th grade)"
        else: return "Very Difficult (College+)"


# --- عرض توضيحي ---
analyzer = TextAnalyzer()

samples = {
    "Simple": (
        "The cat sat on the mat. It was a nice day. "
        "The sun was warm. Birds sang in the trees."
    ),
    "Medium": (
        "Machine learning algorithms process large datasets to identify "
        "patterns and make predictions. These systems improve their "
        "performance over time through experience."
    ),
    "Complex": (
        "The epistemological implications of artificial intelligence "
        "necessitate a fundamental reconceptualization of computational "
        "hermeneutics, particularly regarding the phenomenological "
        "intersection of algorithmic determinism and emergent cognitive "
        "architectures in contemporary technological paradigms."
    ),
}

for label, text in samples.items():
    r = analyzer.analyze(text)
    fre = r["flesch_reading_ease"]
    print(f"=== {label} Text ===")
    print(f"  Words: {r['word_count']}, Sentences: {r['sentence_count']}")
    print(f"  Avg sentence length: {r['avg_sentence_length']} words")
    print(f"  Flesch Reading Ease: {fre} ({analyzer.reading_level_label(fre)})")
    print(f"  Grade level: {r['grade_level']}")
    print(f"  Complex words: {r['complex_word_pct']}%")
    print()

الجزء 2: خط أنابيب تحويل النصوص

يقوم خط أنابيب التحويل بمعالجة نصية قائمة على القواعد — التبسيط، وتقسيم الجمل، وإزالة الحشو — دون الحاجة إلى LLM. هذا مفيد كحل احتياطي عند تعطّل واجهات البرمجة (API)، وللطلبات الخفيفة، وكمعالجة أولية قبل إعادة الصياغة القائمة على LLM.

Python 

# transformer.py - خط أنابيب تحويل النصوص القائم على القواعد

import re

class TextTransformer:
    """تحويلات نصية قائمة على القواعد دون الاعتماد على LLM."""

    SIMPLIFY_MAP = {
        "utilize": "use", "implement": "set up",
        "facilitate": "help", "subsequently": "then",
        "approximately": "about", "demonstrate": "show",
        "consequently": "so", "nevertheless": "still",
        "furthermore": "also", "comprehensive": "full",
        "fundamental": "basic", "methodology": "method",
        "sufficient": "enough", "necessitate": "need",
        "endeavor": "try", "commence": "start",
        "terminate": "end", "modifications": "changes",
        "functionality": "features",
    }

    FILLER_WORDS = [
        "very", "really", "basically", "actually", "literally",
        "definitely", "certainly", "absolutely", "simply",
        "quite", "rather", "somewhat", "just",
    ]

    def simplify_vocabulary(self, text):
        """استبدال الكلمات المعقّدة ببدائل أبسط."""
        result = text
        replacements = []
        for cw, sw in self.SIMPLIFY_MAP.items():
            pattern = re.compile(r"\\b" + cw + r"\\b", re.IGNORECASE)
            if pattern.search(result):
                def repl(m, simple=sw):
                    return simple.capitalize() if m.group(0)[0].isupper() else simple
                result = pattern.sub(repl, result)
                replacements.append(f"{cw} -> {sw}")
        return result, replacements

    def remove_fillers(self, text):
        """إزالة كلمات الحشو والظروف غير الضرورية."""
        removed = []
        result = text
        for filler in self.FILLER_WORDS:
            pattern = re.compile(r"\\b" + filler + r"\\b\\s*", re.IGNORECASE)
            if pattern.search(result):
                result = pattern.sub("", result)
                removed.append(filler)
        return re.sub(r"\\s{2,}", " ", result).strip(), removed

    def split_long_sentences(self, text, max_words=25):
        """تقسيم الجمل الطويلة عند أدوات الربط."""
        conjunctions = [", and ", ", but ", ", which ", "; ", ", however "]
        sentences = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\\s+", text)
        result = []
        for sentence in sentences:
            if len(sentence.split()) > max_words:
                split_done = False
                for conj in conjunctions:
                    if conj in sentence:
                        parts = sentence.split(conj, 1)
                        if len(parts[0].split()) >= 5:
                            result.append(parts[0].strip() + ".")
                            second = parts[1].strip()
                            if second and second[0].islower():
                                second = second[0].upper() + second[1:]
                            result.append(second)
                            split_done = True
                            break
                if not split_done:
                    result.append(sentence)
            else:
                result.append(sentence)
        return " ".join(result)

    def make_concise(self, text):
        """تطبيق كل قواعد التبسيط."""
        text, vocab_changes = self.simplify_vocabulary(text)
        text, fillers_removed = self.remove_fillers(text)
        text = self.split_long_sentences(text)
        return {"text": text, "vocab_changes": vocab_changes,
                "fillers_removed": fillers_removed}


# --- عرض توضيحي ---
transformer = TextTransformer()

sample = (
    "The company will subsequently utilize a very comprehensive "
    "methodology to facilitate the implementation of fundamental "
    "modifications, which will definitely demonstrate the "
    "functionality of the system, and furthermore this will "
    "basically commence a really significant transformation "
    "that will certainly necessitate approximately three months "
    "of quite intensive endeavor to terminate successfully."
)

print("=== Original Text ===")
print(sample)
print(f"Word count: {len(sample.split())}")

result = transformer.make_concise(sample)
print(f"\
=== After All Transforms ===")
print(result["text"])
print(f"Word count: {len(result['text'].split())}")
print(f"Vocabulary swaps: {result['vocab_changes']}")
print(f"Fillers removed: {result['fillers_removed']}")

الجزء 3: قوالب الموجّهات لإعادة الصياغة القائمة على LLM

تأتي القوة الحقيقية لـ ProseAI من إعادة الصياغة القائمة على LLM. لكل نمط (تلخيص، رسمي، عفوي، توسيع، تبسيط) قالب موجّه مصمَّم بعناية. يفصل نظام القوالب بين رسالة النظام (الشخصية) والتعليمة (المهمة) ومحتوى المستخدم (النص المُراد تحويله). قوالب الموجّهات الجيدة هي ميزتك التنافسية — واجهة LLM نفسها متاحة للجميع، لكن قوالبك هي ما يحدّد الجودة.

Python 

# prompts.py - نظام قوالب الموجّهات لـ ProseAI

class PromptTemplateEngine:
    """يدير قوالب الموجّهات لأنماط إعادة الصياغة المختلفة."""

    TEMPLATES = {
        "summarize": {
            "name": "Summarize",
            "description": "Condense text to key points",
            "system": ("You are an expert summarizer. Extract the core meaning "
                       "and key points. Preserve factual accuracy."),
            "instruction": ("Summarize the following text in {length} sentences. "
                            "Keep the most important facts and conclusions."),
            "defaults": {"length": "2-3"},
        },
        "formal": {
            "name": "Formal Tone",
            "description": "Rewrite in professional, formal style",
            "system": ("You are a professional editor specializing in formal "
                       "business and academic writing."),
            "instruction": ("Rewrite the following text in a formal, professional tone. "
                            "Use precise vocabulary, avoid contractions. "
                            "Preserve all factual content."),
            "defaults": {},
        },
        "casual": {
            "name": "Casual Tone",
            "description": "Rewrite in friendly, conversational style",
            "system": ("You are a friendly writer who makes complex topics "
                       "accessible and conversational."),
            "instruction": ("Rewrite the following text in a casual, friendly tone. "
                            "Use everyday language. Do not lose any key information."),
            "defaults": {},
        },
        "expand": {
            "name": "Expand",
            "description": "Elaborate with more detail and examples",
            "system": ("You are a thorough writer who enriches content with "
                       "relevant details and examples."),
            "instruction": ("Expand the following text to approximately {target_length}. "
                            "Add relevant details and examples. "
                            "Do not add speculative information."),
            "defaults": {"target_length": "twice the original length"},
        },
        "simplify": {
            "name": "Simplify",
            "description": "Rewrite for easy reading (grade 6 level)",
            "system": ("You are a plain-language expert. Rewrite text so that "
                       "a 12-year-old can understand it."),
            "instruction": ("Rewrite the following text at a {grade} reading level. "
                            "Use short sentences (under 15 words). "
                            "Replace jargon with simple words."),
            "defaults": {"grade": "6th grade"},
        },
    }

    def build_prompt(self, mode, user_text, **kwargs):
        """بناء موجّه كامل لنمط إعادة الصياغة المحدَّد."""
        if mode not in self.TEMPLATES:
            return {"error": f"Unknown mode: {mode}"}
        t = self.TEMPLATES[mode]
        params = dict(t["defaults"])
        params.update(kwargs)
        instruction = t["instruction"].format(**params)
        return {
            "mode": mode, "mode_name": t["name"],
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": t["system"]},
                {"role": "user", "content": f"{instruction}\
\
---\
\
{user_text}"},
            ],
        }

    def list_modes(self):
        return {k: {"name": t["name"], "description": t["description"],
                     "params": list(t["defaults"].keys())}
                for k, t in self.TEMPLATES.items()}


# --- عرض توضيحي ---
engine = PromptTemplateEngine()

print("=== Available Rewriting Modes ===")
for mid, info in engine.list_modes().items():
    p = f" (params: {info['params']})" if info["params"] else ""
    print(f"  {mid:12s} - {info['description']}{p}")

sample = (
    "The implementation of machine learning algorithms in production "
    "environments necessitates careful consideration of computational "
    "resources and model versioning strategies."
)
print(f"\
Input: {sample}\
")

for mode in ["summarize", "formal", "casual", "simplify"]:
    r = engine.build_prompt(mode, sample)
    user_msg = r["messages"][1]["content"]
    instr = user_msg[:user_msg.find("---")].strip()

الجزء 4: الاستجابات البثّية (Streaming)

يتوقع المستخدمون رؤية النص يظهر كلمة بكلمة، كما في ChatGPT. يحسّن البث زمن الاستجابة المُدرَك بشكل كبير — فبدلًا من الانتظار 5 ثوانٍ للحصول على استجابة كاملة، يرى المستخدمون الكلمة الأولى في أقل من 200 مللي ثانية. يستخدم ProseAI مولّدات Python وأحداث Server-Sent Events (SSE) لبثّ النص المُعاد صياغته إلى الواجهة الأمامية في الوقت الفعلي.

Python 

# streaming.py - مولّد الاستجابة البثّية لـ ProseAI

import json
import re

class StreamingRewriter:
    """توليد نص بثّي باستخدام نمط المولّد (generator).
    في الإنتاج، يغلّف هذا استجابة بث واجهة LLM."""

    def sse_format(self, data):
        """تنسيق البيانات كسلسلة Server-Sent Event."""
        return f"data: {json.dumps(data)}\
\
"

    def stream_rewrite(self, original, rewritten, mode):
        """خط أنابيب بثّي كامل: بداية، رموز (tokens)، انتهاء."""
        # 1. حدث البداية
        yield self.sse_format({
            "type": "start", "mode": mode,
            "original_length": len(original.split()),
        })
        # 2. البث كلمة بكلمة
        words = rewritten.split()
        for i, word in enumerate(words):
            yield self.sse_format({
                "type": "token", "content": word + " ", "index": i,
            })
        # 3. حدث الانتهاء مع الإحصائيات
        yield self.sse_format({
            "type": "done",
            "original_words": len(original.split()),
            "rewritten_words": len(words),
            "compression": round(len(words) / max(len(original.split()), 1), 2),
        })


# --- عرض توضيحي ---
streamer = StreamingRewriter()

original = (
    "The implementation of machine learning algorithms in production "
    "environments necessitates careful consideration of computational "
    "resources, data pipeline architecture, and model versioning."
)
rewritten = (
    "Putting ML models into production means thinking about three things. "
    "First, you need enough computing power. Second, your data pipelines "
    "must be solid. Third, keep track of your model versions."
)

events = list(streamer.stream_rewrite(original, rewritten, "simplify"))
print(f"Total SSE events: {len(events)}")

# التحليل والعرض
output = ""
for event_str in events:
    data = json.loads(event_str.replace("data: ", "").strip())
    if data["type"] == "start":
        print(f"[START] Mode: {data['mode']}, Input: {data['original_length']} words")
    elif data["type"] == "token":
        output += data["content"]
    elif data["type"] == "done":
        print(f"[OUTPUT] {output.strip()}")
        print(f"[DONE] {data['original_words']} -> {data['rewritten_words']} words "
              f"({data['compression']}x)")

print(f"\
Sample SSE event:\
  {events[2].strip()}")

app/main.py
"""ProseAI API Server - Text Composition and Rewriting SaaS."""
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Depends, Header
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
import uuid, time, asyncio

from .config import settings
from .analyzer import TextAnalyzer
from .transformer import TextTransformer
from .prompts import PromptTemplateEngine
from .streaming import StreamingRewriter

app = FastAPI(title="ProseAI API", version="1.0.0")
app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory="static"), name="static")

analyzer = TextAnalyzer()
transformer = TextTransformer()
prompt_engine = PromptTemplateEngine()
streamer = StreamingRewriter()

class RewriteRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str = Field(..., min_length=10, max_length=10000)
    mode: str = Field(default="simplify")
    stream: bool = Field(default=False)
    params: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)

class AnalyzeRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str = Field(..., min_length=10, max_length=10000)

async def get_user(x_api_key: str = Header(...)):
    if not x_api_key:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="API key required")
    return {"id": "user_1", "tier": "pro"}

@app.get("/api/modes")
async def list_modes():
    return {"modes": prompt_engine.list_modes()}

@app.post("/api/analyze")
async def analyze_text(req: AnalyzeRequest):
    result = analyzer.analyze(req.text)
    result["reading_level"] = analyzer.reading_level_label(
        result["flesch_reading_ease"])
    return result

@app.post("/api/rewrite")
async def rewrite_text(req: RewriteRequest, user=Depends(get_user)):
    """إعادة صياغة النص وفق النمط المحدَّد. يدعم البث عبر SSE."""
    prompt_data = prompt_engine.build_prompt(req.mode, req.text, **req.params)
    if "error" in prompt_data:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=prompt_data["error"])

    if req.stream:
        async def event_generator():
            # في الإنتاج: بث من واجهة LLM باستخدام prompt_data
            result = transformer.make_concise(req.text)
            for event in streamer.stream_rewrite(
                    req.text, result["text"], req.mode):
                yield event
                await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
        return StreamingResponse(event_generator(),
            media_type="text/event-stream",
            headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache", "X-Accel-Buffering": "no"})

    # بدون بث: إرجاع استجابة JSON كاملة
    start = time.time()
    result = transformer.make_concise(req.text)
    return {
        "id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "mode": req.mode,
        "rewritten_text": result["text"],
        "analysis_before": analyzer.analyze(req.text),
        "analysis_after": analyzer.analyze(result["text"]),
        "processing_time": round(time.time() - start, 3),
    }

@app.get("/api/health")
async def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "service": "proseai"}

الجزء 11: الاتصال بنموذجك الخاص

حتى الآن استخدمنا واجهات برمجة تطبيقات (API) من أطراف ثالثة. لكن القوة الحقيقية — والهوامش الحقيقية — تأتي عندما تشغّل نماذجك الخاصة. هذا يلغي تكاليف API لكل طلب، ويمنحك تحكمًا كاملًا في زمن الاستجابة والخصوصية، ويتيح لك ضبط النماذج (fine-tune) لحالتك الاستخدامية المحدَّدة.

ثلاثة أساليب رئيسية للاستضافة الذاتية:

  • vLLM — أعلى إنتاجية، واجهة برمجة متوافقة مع OpenAI، الأفضل للإنتاج

الجزء 13: تحديد المعدّل (Rate Limiting) وحماية API

يحتاج كل منتج SaaS إنتاجي إلى تحديد المعدّل لمنع سوء الاستخدام والتحكم في التكاليف وضمان استخدام عادل. إليك تنفيذًا بمستوى إنتاجي:

rate_limiter.py — تحديد المعدّل الإنتاجي لـ ProseAI
"""
تحديد المعدّل الإنتاجي لـ ProseAI.
ثلاثة مستويات: في الذاكرة (التطوير)، Redis (الإنتاج)، دلو الرموز token bucket (متقدّم).
"""
import time
from collections import defaultdict

# === المستوى 1: محدِّد المعدّل في الذاكرة (التطوير) ===
class InMemoryRateLimiter:
    """محدِّد معدّل بنافذة منزلقة بسيط. يعمل لإعداد خادم واحد."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.requests = defaultdict(list)

    def is_allowed(self, key, max_requests, window_seconds):
        """التحقق مما إذا كان الطلب مسموحًا ضمن حد المعدّل."""
        now = time.time()
        window_start = now - window_seconds

        # تنظيف الإدخالات القديمة
        self.requests[key] = [t for t in self.requests[key] if t > window_start]

        if len(self.requests[key]) >= max_requests:
            retry_after = self.requests[key][0] - window_start
            return False, {{
                "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                "limit": max_requests,
                "window": window_seconds,
                "retry_after": round(retry_after, 1),
                "current": len(self.requests[key])
            }}

        self.requests[key].append(now)
        return True, {{
            "remaining": max_requests - len(self.requests[key]),
            "limit": max_requests,
            "reset": round(window_start + window_seconds - now, 1)
        }}

# === المستوى 2: محدِّد المعدّل عبر Redis (الإنتاج) ===
class RedisRateLimiter:
    """محدِّد معدّل قائم على Redis للنشر الموزَّع.

    في الإنتاج، ثبِّت: pip install redis
    واستخدم اتصال Redis حقيقيًا.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        # في الإنتاج: self.redis = redis.Redis(host='redis', port=6379, db=0)
        self.memory = defaultdict(list)  # محاكاة Redis

    def check_rate_limit(self, user_id, tier="free"):
        """التحقق من حد المعدّل بناءً على فئة المستخدم."""
        limits = {{
            "free":       {{"requests_per_minute": 5,  "requests_per_day": 50}},
            "starter":    {{"requests_per_minute": 20, "requests_per_day": 500}},
            "pro":        {{"requests_per_minute": 60, "requests_per_day": 5000}},
            "enterprise": {{"requests_per_minute": 200, "requests_per_day": 50000}},
        }}

        tier_limits = limits.get(tier, limits["free"])
        now = time.time()

        # التحقق من حد الدقيقة
        minute_key = f"rate:{{user_id}}:minute"
        self.memory[minute_key] = [t for t in self.memory[minute_key] if t > now - 60]

        if len(self.memory[minute_key]) >= tier_limits["requests_per_minute"]:
            return False, {{
                "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                "type": "per_minute",
                "limit": tier_limits["requests_per_minute"],
                "retry_after_seconds": 60 - (now - self.memory[minute_key][0])
            }}

        # التحقق من حد اليوم
        day_key = f"rate:{{user_id}}:day"
        self.memory[day_key] = [t for t in self.memory[day_key] if t > now - 86400]

        if len(self.memory[day_key]) >= tier_limits["requests_per_day"]:
            return False, {{
                "error": "daily_limit_exceeded",
                "type": "per_day",
                "limit": tier_limits["requests_per_day"],
            }}

        # السماح بالطلب
        self.memory[minute_key].append(now)
        self.memory[day_key].append(now)

        return True, {{
            "remaining_minute": tier_limits["requests_per_minute"] - len(self.memory[minute_key]),
            "remaining_day": tier_limits["requests_per_day"] - len(self.memory[day_key]),
        }}

# === وسيط FastAPI (Middleware) ===
class RateLimitMiddleware:
    """
    وسيط FastAPI لتحديد المعدّل.

    الاستخدام في تطبيقك:
        from rate_limiter import RateLimitMiddleware
        app.add_middleware(RateLimitMiddleware)

    أو كتبعية (dependency):
        @app.get("/generate")
        async def generate(rate_limit: dict = Depends(check_rate_limit)):
            ...
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.limiter = RedisRateLimiter()

    def get_middleware_code(self):
        """طباعة كود وسيط FastAPI الفعلي."""
        code = "# Add to your FastAPI app:\
\
"
        code += "from fastapi import Request, Response\
"
        code += "from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware\
\
"
        code += "class RateLimitMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):\
"
        code += "    async def dispatch(self, request, call_next):\
"
        code += "        api_key = request.headers.get('X-API-Key', 'anonymous')\
"
        code += "        user_id = self.get_user_from_key(api_key)\
"
        code += "        tier = self.get_user_tier(user_id)\
"
        code += "        allowed, info = self.limiter.check_rate_limit(user_id, tier)\
"
        code += "        if not allowed:\
"
        code += "            return JSONResponse(status_code=429, content=info)\
"
        code += "        response = await call_next(request)\
"
        code += "        response.headers['X-RateLimit-Remaining'] = str(info.get('remaining_minute', 0))\
"
        code += "        return response\
"
        print(code)


# --- عرض توضيحي ---
print("=== Rate Limiting Demo for ProseAI ===\
")

limiter = RedisRateLimiter()

# محاكاة طلبات من مستخدمين مختلفين
users = [
    ("user_free_1", "free"),
    ("user_pro_1", "pro"),
    ("user_enterprise_1", "enterprise"),
]

for user_id, tier in users:
    print(f"User: {{user_id}} ({{tier}} tier)")
    for i in range(8):
        allowed, info = limiter.check_rate_limit(user_id, tier)
        status = "ALLOWED" if allowed else "BLOCKED"
        print(f"  Request {{i+1}}: {{status}} | {{info}}")
        if not allowed:
            break
    print()

# عرض كود الوسيط
mw = RateLimitMiddleware()
mw.get_middleware_code()

    def create_usage_record(self, subscription_item_id, quantity, action="increment"):
        """تسجيل الاستخدام للفوترة المقاسة (الدفع حسب الاستخدام فوق الاشتراك)."""

        return {{"status": "recorded", "quantity": quantity}}

    def handle_webhook(self, event_type, data):
        """معالجة أحداث webhook من Stripe."""
        handlers = {{
            "checkout.session.completed": self._on_checkout_complete,
            "customer.subscription.updated": self._on_subscription_update,
            "customer.subscription.deleted": self._on_subscription_cancel,
            "invoice.payment_failed": self._on_payment_failed,
            "invoice.paid": self._on_invoice_paid,
        }}

        handler = handlers.get(event_type)
        if handler:
            return handler(data)
        return {{"status": "unhandled", "event": event_type}}

    def _on_checkout_complete(self, data):
        print(f"  Checkout completed! Activate subscription for user.")
        return {{"action": "activate_subscription"}}

    def _on_subscription_update(self, data):
        print(f"  Subscription updated. Sync plan tier in database.")
        return {{"action": "sync_tier"}}

    def _on_subscription_cancel(self, data):
        print(f"  Subscription canceled. Downgrade to free tier.")
        return {{"action": "downgrade_to_free"}}

    def _on_payment_failed(self, data):
        print(f"  Payment failed! Send dunning email, grace period 7 days.")
        return {{"action": "send_dunning_email", "grace_days": 7}}

    def _on_invoice_paid(self, data):
        print(f"  Invoice paid. Reset monthly usage counters.")
        return {{"action": "reset_usage"}}

    def get_fastapi_webhook_code(self):
        """طباعة كود نقطة نهاية webhook الخاصة بـ FastAPI."""
        code = "# FastAPI webhook endpoint:\
\
"

"

"

"

"

"

"
        code += "            payload, sig_header, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET)\
"
        code += "    except stripe.error.SignatureVerificationError:\
"
        code += "        raise HTTPException(400, 'Invalid signature')\
"
        code += "    billing = StripeBilling()\
"
        code += "    result = billing.handle_webhook(event['type'], event['data']['object'])\
"
        code += "    return {'status': 'ok', 'result': result}\
"
        print(code)

الخلاصات الرئيسية

  • حلِّل قبل أن تحوِّل: قياس سهولة القراءة وتعقيد الجمل وتكرار الكلمات يمنحك مقاييس موضوعية. يتيح لك ذلك عرض مقارنة “قبل مقابل بعد” تُثبت للمستخدمين أن خدمتك تضيف قيمة.
  • التحويلات القائمة على القواعد هي شبكة الأمان لديك: تبسيط المفردات وإزالة الحشو وتقسيم الجمل تعمل دون اتصال ولا تكلّف شيئًا. استخدمها كحلول احتياطية عند تعطّل واجهات LLM.
  • قوالب الموجّهات هي خندقك الدفاعي: واجهة LLM نفسها متاحة للجميع. قوالب الموجّهات المصمَّمة بعناية لديك — مع رسائل النظام والتعليمات والقيود — هي ما يحدّد الجودة والاتساق.
  • البث إلزامي لمنتجات النصوص: لن ينتظر المستخدمون 5 إلى 10 ثوانٍ محدّقين في مؤشر تحميل. البث كلمة بكلمة عبر SSE يجعل المنتج يبدو فوريًا وجذابًا.
  • افصل الاهتمامات بوضوح: Analyzer وTransformer وPromptEngine وStreamer وحدات مستقلة. يمكن اختبار كل منها أو استبدالها أو ترقيتها دون المساس بالأخرى.

التالي: في GenAI-4، ستبني منتج SaaS لتوليد الأكواد — يتعامل مع التحويلات المدركة للصياغة، ودعم لغات متعددة، وبيئات تنفيذ أكواد آمنة (sandboxes).

"""ProseAI API Server - Text Composition and Rewriting SaaS."""
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Depends, Header
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
import uuid, time, asyncio

from .config import settings
from .analyzer import TextAnalyzer
from .transformer import TextTransformer
from .prompts import PromptTemplateEngine
from .streaming import StreamingRewriter

app = FastAPI(title="ProseAI API", version="1.0.0")
app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory="static"), name="static")

analyzer = TextAnalyzer()
transformer = TextTransformer()
prompt_engine = PromptTemplateEngine()
streamer = StreamingRewriter()

class RewriteRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str = Field(..., min_length=10, max_length=10000)
    mode: str = Field(default="simplify")
    stream: bool = Field(default=False)
    params: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)

class AnalyzeRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str = Field(..., min_length=10, max_length=10000)

async def get_user(x_api_key: str = Header(...)):
    if not x_api_key:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="API key required")
    return {"id": "user_1", "tier": "pro"}

@app.get("/api/modes")
async def list_modes():
    return {"modes": prompt_engine.list_modes()}

@app.post("/api/analyze")
async def analyze_text(req: AnalyzeRequest):
    result = analyzer.analyze(req.text)
    result["reading_level"] = analyzer.reading_level_label(
        result["flesch_reading_ease"])
    return result

@app.post("/api/rewrite")
async def rewrite_text(req: RewriteRequest, user=Depends(get_user)):
    """Rewrite text in the specified mode. Supports streaming via SSE."""
    prompt_data = prompt_engine.build_prompt(req.mode, req.text, **req.params)
    if "error" in prompt_data:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=prompt_data["error"])

    if req.stream:
        async def event_generator():
            # In production: stream from LLM API using prompt_data
            result = transformer.make_concise(req.text)
            for event in streamer.stream_rewrite(
                    req.text, result["text"], req.mode):
                yield event
                await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
        return StreamingResponse(event_generator(),
            media_type="text/event-stream",
            headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache", "X-Accel-Buffering": "no"})

    # Non-streaming: return complete JSON response
    start = time.time()
    result = transformer.make_concise(req.text)
    return {
        "id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "mode": req.mode,
        "rewritten_text": result["text"],
        "analysis_before": analyzer.analyze(req.text),
        "analysis_after": analyzer.analyze(result["text"]),
        "processing_time": round(time.time() - start, 3),
    }

@app.get("/api/health")
async def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "service": "proseai"}

"""Streaming Rewriter for ProseAI - Server-Sent Events support."""
import json
import asyncio
import httpx
from typing import AsyncGenerator
from app.config import Settings
from app.prompts import PromptTemplateEngine


class StreamingRewriter:
    """Generates SSE events for real-time text rewriting."""

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings):
        self.settings = settings
        self.prompt_engine = PromptTemplateEngine()
        self.api_key = settings.OPENAI_API_KEY
        self.api_base = getattr(settings, "LLM_BASE_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1")
        self.model = getattr(settings, "LLM_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")

    async def rewrite_stream(
        self, text: str, mode: str
    ) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
        """Stream rewritten text as SSE events.

        Yields SSE-formatted strings: data: {"token": "..."}
        Ends with: data: {"done": true}
        """
        prompts = self.prompt_engine.build_prompt(text, mode)

        if not self.api_key:
            # Demo mode: simulate streaming with rule-based output
            from app.transformer import TextTransformer
            transformer = TextTransformer(self.settings)
            result = transformer._rule_based_fallback(text, mode)
            for word in result.split():
                yield f'data: {json.dumps({"token": word + " "})}\n\n'
                await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
            yield f'data: {json.dumps({"done": True})}\n\n'
            return

        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        }
        payload = {
            "model": self.model,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": prompts["system"]},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompts["user"]},
            ],
            "temperature": 0.7,
            "max_tokens": 2048,
            "stream": True,
        }

        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
            async with client.stream(
                "POST",
                f"{self.api_base}/chat/completions",
                json=payload,
                headers=headers,
                timeout=60.0,
            ) as response:
                response.raise_for_status()
                async for line in response.aiter_lines():
                    if not line.startswith("data: "):
                        continue
                    chunk = line[6:]
                    if chunk == "[DONE]":
                        break
                    try:
                        data = json.loads(chunk)
                        delta = data["choices"][0].get("delta", {})
                        token = delta.get("content", "")
                        if token:
                            yield f'data: {json.dumps({"token": token})}\n\n'
                    except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, IndexError):
                        continue

        yield f'data: {json.dumps({"done": True})}\n\n'

"""
Production rate limiting for ProseAI.
Three tiers: in-memory (development), Redis (production), token bucket (advanced).
"""
import time
from collections import defaultdict

# === TIER 1: In-Memory Rate Limiter (Development) ===
class InMemoryRateLimiter:
    """Simple sliding window rate limiter. Works for single-server setup."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.requests = defaultdict(list)

    def is_allowed(self, key, max_requests, window_seconds):
        """Check if request is allowed under the rate limit."""
        now = time.time()
        window_start = now - window_seconds

        # Clean old entries
        self.requests[key] = [t for t in self.requests[key] if t > window_start]

        if len(self.requests[key]) >= max_requests:
            retry_after = self.requests[key][0] - window_start
            return False, {
                "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                "limit": max_requests,
                "window": window_seconds,
                "retry_after": round(retry_after, 1),
                "current": len(self.requests[key])
            }

        self.requests[key].append(now)
        return True, {
            "remaining": max_requests - len(self.requests[key]),
            "limit": max_requests,
            "reset": round(window_start + window_seconds - now, 1)
        }

# === TIER 2: Redis Rate Limiter (Production) ===
class RedisRateLimiter:
    """Redis-based rate limiter for distributed deployments.

    In production, install: pip install redis
    And use a real Redis connection.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        # In production: self.redis = redis.Redis(host='redis', port=6379, db=0)
        self.memory = defaultdict(list)  # Simulating Redis

    def check_rate_limit(self, user_id, tier="free"):
        """Check rate limit based on user tier."""
        limits = {
            "free":       {"requests_per_minute": 5,  "requests_per_day": 50},
            "starter":    {"requests_per_minute": 20, "requests_per_day": 500},
            "pro":        {"requests_per_minute": 60, "requests_per_day": 5000},
            "enterprise": {"requests_per_minute": 200, "requests_per_day": 50000},
        }

        tier_limits = limits.get(tier, limits["free"])
        now = time.time()

        # Check per-minute limit
        minute_key = f"rate:{{user_id}}:minute"
        self.memory[minute_key] = [t for t in self.memory[minute_key] if t > now - 60]

        if len(self.memory[minute_key]) >= tier_limits["requests_per_minute"]:
            return False, {
                "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                "type": "per_minute",
                "limit": tier_limits["requests_per_minute"],
                "retry_after_seconds": 60 - (now - self.memory[minute_key][0])
            }

        # Check per-day limit
        day_key = f"rate:{{user_id}}:day"
        self.memory[day_key] = [t for t in self.memory[day_key] if t > now - 86400]

        if len(self.memory[day_key]) >= tier_limits["requests_per_day"]:
            return False, {
                "error": "daily_limit_exceeded",
                "type": "per_day",
                "limit": tier_limits["requests_per_day"],
            }

        # Allow request
        self.memory[minute_key].append(now)
        self.memory[day_key].append(now)

        return True, {
            "remaining_minute": tier_limits["requests_per_minute"] - len(self.memory[minute_key]),
            "remaining_day": tier_limits["requests_per_day"] - len(self.memory[day_key]),
        }

# === FastAPI Middleware ===
class RateLimitMiddleware:
    """
    FastAPI middleware for rate limiting.

    Usage in your app:
        from rate_limiter import RateLimitMiddleware
        app.add_middleware(RateLimitMiddleware)

    Or as a dependency:
        @app.get("/generate")
        async def generate(rate_limit: dict = Depends(check_rate_limit)):
            ...
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.limiter = RedisRateLimiter()

    def get_middleware_code(self):
        """Print the actual FastAPI middleware code."""
        code = "# Add to your FastAPI app:\n\n"
        code += "from fastapi import Request, Response\n"
        code += "from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware\n\n"
        code += "class RateLimitMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):\n"
        code += "    async def dispatch(self, request, call_next):\n"
        code += "        api_key = request.headers.get('X-API-Key', 'anonymous')\n"
        code += "        user_id = self.get_user_from_key(api_key)\n"
        code += "        tier = self.get_user_tier(user_id)\n"
        code += "        allowed, info = self.limiter.check_rate_limit(user_id, tier)\n"
        code += "        if not allowed:\n"
        code += "            return JSONResponse(status_code=429, content=info)\n"
        code += "        response = await call_next(request)\n"
        code += "        response.headers['X-RateLimit-Remaining'] = str(info.get('remaining_minute', 0))\n"
        code += "        return response\n"
        print(code)


# --- Demo ---
print("=== Rate Limiting Demo for ProseAI ===\n")

limiter = RedisRateLimiter()

# Simulate requests from different users
users = [
    ("user_free_1", "free"),
    ("user_pro_1", "pro"),
    ("user_enterprise_1", "enterprise"),
]

for user_id, tier in users:
    print(f"User: {{user_id}} ({{tier}} tier)")
    for i in range(8):
        allowed, info = limiter.check_rate_limit(user_id, tier)
        status = "ALLOWED" if allowed else "BLOCKED"
        print(f"  Request {{i+1}}: {{status}} | {{info}}")
        if not allowed:
            break
    print()

# Show middleware code
mw = RateLimitMiddleware()
mw.get_middleware_code()

"""
Complete Stripe billing for ProseAI.
Supports: subscription tiers, usage-based billing, webhooks.

Setup:
  pip install stripe
  # Get keys from https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys
  # Set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in .env
"""

class StripeBilling:
    """Full Stripe integration for SaaS billing."""

    def __init__(self, secret_key="sk_test_..."):
        # In production: import stripe; stripe.api_key = secret_key
        self.plans = {
            "free":       {"price": 0,    "name": "Free",       "stripe_price_id": None},
            "starter":    {"price": 19,   "name": "Starter",    "stripe_price_id": "price_starter_monthly"},
            "pro":        {"price": 49,   "name": "Professional","stripe_price_id": "price_pro_monthly"},
            "enterprise": {"price": 199,  "name": "Enterprise", "stripe_price_id": "price_enterprise_monthly"},
        }

    def create_checkout_session(self, user_email, plan_key):
        """Create a Stripe Checkout session for subscription."""
        plan = self.plans[plan_key]
        if plan["price"] == 0:
            return {"status": "free_tier", "message": "No payment needed"}

        # In production:
        # session = stripe.checkout.Session.create(
        #     customer_email=user_email,
        #     payment_method_types=["card"],
        #     line_items=[{
        #         "price": plan["stripe_price_id"],
        #         "quantity": 1,
        #     }],
        #     mode="subscription",
        #     success_url="https://{product_name.lower()}.com/billing/success?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}",
        #     cancel_url="https://{product_name.lower()}.com/billing/cancel",
        #     metadata={"user_email": user_email, "plan": plan_key},
        # )
        # return {"checkout_url": session.url, "session_id": session.id}

        print(f"Creating checkout for {{user_email}} -> {{plan['name']}} (\${{plan['price']}}/mo)")
        return {
            "checkout_url": f"https://checkout.stripe.com/pay/cs_test_...",
            "plan": plan["name"],
            "price": f"\${{plan['price']}}/month"
        }

    def create_usage_record(self, subscription_item_id, quantity, action="increment"):
        """Record usage for metered billing (pay-per-use on top of subscription)."""
        # In production:
        # stripe.SubscriptionItem.create_usage_record(
        #     subscription_item_id,
        #     quantity=quantity,
        #     action=action,
        #     timestamp=int(time.time())
        # )
        print(f"Usage recorded: {{quantity}} units on {{subscription_item_id}}")
        return {"status": "recorded", "quantity": quantity}

    def handle_webhook(self, event_type, data):
        """Handle Stripe webhook events."""
        handlers = {
            "checkout.session.completed": self._on_checkout_complete,
            "customer.subscription.updated": self._on_subscription_update,
            "customer.subscription.deleted": self._on_subscription_cancel,
            "invoice.payment_failed": self._on_payment_failed,
            "invoice.paid": self._on_invoice_paid,
        }

        handler = handlers.get(event_type)
        if handler:
            return handler(data)
        return {"status": "unhandled", "event": event_type}

    def _on_checkout_complete(self, data):
        print(f"  Checkout completed! Activate subscription for user.")
        return {"action": "activate_subscription"}

    def _on_subscription_update(self, data):
        print(f"  Subscription updated. Sync plan tier in database.")
        return {"action": "sync_tier"}

    def _on_subscription_cancel(self, data):
        print(f"  Subscription canceled. Downgrade to free tier.")
        return {"action": "downgrade_to_free"}

    def _on_payment_failed(self, data):
        print(f"  Payment failed! Send dunning email, grace period 7 days.")
        return {"action": "send_dunning_email", "grace_days": 7}

    def _on_invoice_paid(self, data):
        print(f"  Invoice paid. Reset monthly usage counters.")
        return {"action": "reset_usage"}

    def get_fastapi_webhook_code(self):
        """Print the FastAPI webhook endpoint code."""
        code = "# FastAPI webhook endpoint:\n\n"
        code += "@app.post('/webhooks/stripe')\n"
        code += "async def stripe_webhook(request: Request):\n"
        code += "    payload = await request.body()\n"
        code += "    sig_header = request.headers.get('stripe-signature')\n"
        code += "    try:\n"
        code += "        event = stripe.Webhook.construct_event(\n"
        code += "            payload, sig_header, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET)\n"
        code += "    except stripe.error.SignatureVerificationError:\n"
        code += "        raise HTTPException(400, 'Invalid signature')\n"
        code += "    billing = StripeBilling()\n"
        code += "    result = billing.handle_webhook(event['type'], event['data']['object'])\n"
        code += "    return {'status': 'ok', 'result': result}\n"
        print(code)

    def get_pricing_page_data(self):

        }
        return features

"""
Scaling ProseAI from 100 to 1,000,000 users.
Covers: horizontal scaling, queue-based processing, caching, monitoring.
"""

class ScalingPlaybook:
    """Complete scaling guide from MVP to enterprise."""

    def __init__(self, product="ProseAI"):
        self.product = product

    def stage_1_mvp(self):
        """Stage 1: 0-100 users, single server."""
        print("=== Stage 1: MVP (0-100 users) ===")
        print("Architecture: Single server, SQLite/PostgreSQL")
        print("Cost: $5-20/month")
        print()
        print("Stack:")
        print("  - 1x server (Railway/Render free tier)")
        print("  - SQLite or managed PostgreSQL")
        print("  - In-memory caching (Python dict)")
        print("  - Direct API calls (no queue)")
        print()
        print("Focus on:")
        print("  1. Validate product-market fit")
        print("  2. Get 10 paying customers")
        print("  3. Measure: response time, error rate, user retention")

    def stage_2_growth(self):
        """Stage 2: 100-1K users, add resilience."""
        print("\n=== Stage 2: Growth (100-1,000 users) ===")
        print("Architecture: App server + Background workers + Redis")
        print("Cost: $50-200/month")
        print()
        print("Changes from Stage 1:")
        print("  1. Add Redis for caching and rate limiting")
        print("  2. Move heavy work to background queues (Celery/ARQ)")
        print("  3. Add health checks and basic monitoring")
        print("  4. Set up CI/CD pipeline")
        print()
        print("docker-compose additions:")
        print("  redis:")
        print("    image: redis:7-alpine")
        print("  worker:")
        print("    build: .")
        print("    command: arq app.worker.WorkerSettings")
        print("    depends_on: [redis]")
        print()
        print("Queue pattern for heavy tasks:")
        print("  @app.post('/generate')")
        print("  async def generate(request: GenerateRequest):")
        print("      job_id = str(uuid.uuid4())")
        print("      await redis.enqueue_job('process_generation',")
        print("          job_id=job_id, prompt=request.prompt)")
        print("      return {'job_id': job_id, 'status': 'processing'}")
        print()
        print("  @app.get('/jobs/{job_id}')")
        print("  async def get_job(job_id: str):")
        print("      result = await redis.get(f'job:{{job_id}}')")
        print("      return result or {'status': 'processing'}")

    def stage_3_scale(self):
        """Stage 3: 1K-10K users, horizontal scaling."""
        print("\n=== Stage 3: Scale (1,000-10,000 users) ===")
        print("Architecture: Load balancer + Multiple app servers + Queue")
        print("Cost: $200-1,000/month")
        print()
        print("Architecture diagram:")
        print("  Users -> CDN (Cloudflare)")
        print("       -> Load Balancer (nginx/ALB)")
        print("       -> App Server 1 \\ ")
        print("       -> App Server 2  |-> PostgreSQL (managed)")
        print("       -> App Server 3 /    |-> Redis Cluster")
        print("       -> Worker 1 \\         |-> S3 (file storage)")
        print("       -> Worker 2  |-> Queue (Redis/SQS)")
        print("       -> Worker 3 /")
        print()
        print("Key changes:")
        print("  1. Multiple app servers behind load balancer")
        print("  2. Managed database (RDS/Cloud SQL)")
        print("  3. Separate worker pool for heavy processing")
        print("  4. CDN for static assets and cached responses")
        print("  5. Structured logging + APM (Datadog/Grafana)")
        print()
        print("nginx load balancer config:")
        print("  upstream api {")
        print("      least_conn;")
        print("      server app1:8000;")
        print("      server app2:8000;")
        print("      server app3:8000;")
        print("  }")
        print("  server {")
        print("      listen 80;")
        print("      location / {")
        print("          proxy_pass http://api;")
        print("          proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;")
        print("      }")
        print("      location /health {")
        print("          proxy_pass http://api;")
        print("          access_log off;")
        print("      }")
        print("  }")

    def stage_4_mass(self):
        """Stage 4: 10K+ users, enterprise features."""
        print("\n=== Stage 4: Mass Product (10,000+ users) ===")
        print("Architecture: Microservices or modular monolith")
        print("Cost: $1,000-10,000/month")
        print()
        print("Enterprise features to add:")
        print("  1. Multi-tenant architecture (org-level isolation)")
        print("  2. SSO/SAML authentication")
        print("  3. Audit logging")
        print("  4. Data residency (EU/US regions)")
        print("  5. Custom SLAs and dedicated support")
        print("  6. API versioning (v1, v2)")
        print("  7. Webhook system for integrations")
        print("  8. Admin dashboard with analytics")
        print()
        print("Monitoring stack:")
        print("  - Prometheus + Grafana (metrics)")
        print("  - Sentry (error tracking)")
        print("  - PostHog or Mixpanel (product analytics)")
        print("  - PagerDuty (alerting)")
        print()
        print("SLA targets:")
        print("  - Uptime: 99.9% (8.7 hours downtime/year)")
        print("  - API latency p99: < 2 seconds")
        print("  - Error rate: < 0.1%")

    def growth_metrics(self):
        """Key metrics to track at each stage."""
        print("\n=== Key Metrics Dashboard ===")
        print()
        metrics = [
            ("MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue)", "$0", "$500", "$5K", "$50K+"),
            ("Active Users (DAU)", "10", "100", "1,000", "10,000+"),
            ("API Requests/day", "100", "5K", "100K", "1M+"),
            ("Error Rate", "<5%", "<1%", "<0.1%", "<0.01%"),
            ("P99 Latency", "<5s", "<3s", "<2s", "<1s"),
            ("Churn Rate (monthly)", "N/A", "<10%", "<5%", "<3%"),
        ]
        print(f"| {{'Metric':<30}} | {{'Stage 1':<8}} | {{'Stage 2':<8}} | {{'Stage 3':<8}} | {{'Stage 4':<10}} |")
        print(f"|{{'-'*30}}-|{{'-'*8}}-|{{'-'*8}}-|{{'-'*8}}-|{{'-'*10}}-|")
        for name, *stages in metrics:
            print(f"| {{name:<30}} | {{stages[0]:<8}} | {{stages[1]:<8}} | {{stages[2]:<8}} | {{stages[3]:<10}} |")

# --- Demo ---
